$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (ru column), checked one by one against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (ru values, 2026-10-06) and the app’s quota list (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName); §7.2.2 rules ①–③; §7.2.3 (the site writes Plus, the app shows “Плюс” in user_type_plus); §7.3 ru row (вы; «проведите вправо», «дважды коснитесь»).

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app’s names (rule ①). The swipe kicker is the feature name daily_sentence_translation_limit «Проведите для перевода» (ru has no value for the 右滑翻译 short name); the lookup kicker drops the «(AI Значение)» suffix like en / ja, the lookup row keeps the full name. Quota rows follow the app’s own list: feature name + engine, word_meaning_lookup_title, more_definitions_title, ai_pronunciation_*, Chunk Extraction, sentence_skeleton_ui_analyze «Ход действий», grammar_structure_analysis. The app writes title case (Извлечение Фрагментов, Предложение за Предложением, Обновить Сейчас) and mixes AI / ИИ: quoted names keep the app’s spelling, sentences use ИИ and normal Russian case (reported in docs/redesign-2026/ops/m3/ru-qa.md).

contains: app button / setting names that sentences quote verbatim in « » (rule ①; T-B get_syntax_explanation_button, T-C audio_playback_title_* and translation_mode_title_*, T-E upgrade_now_button / restore_purchase_button).

banned: left swipes (F14), mouse double-click wording (X7 by analogy), a single tap for lookup (doc 08 §1.1), the app’s “Плюс” (doc 08 §7.2.3), slang “тап” (doc 08 §7.3 uses «дважды коснитесь»), “чанк” (SurfEnglish-owned jargon; the app name is «Извлечение Фрагментов»), line-by-line “построчный” wording.

banned.note: the gesture is a right swipe; a left swipe removes the translation (F14)
touch gesture, not a mouse double-click (doc 08 §7.2.2 X7 by analogy)
lookup is a double tap, never a single tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
the site writes Plus like the App Store IAP name; the app’s user_type_plus shows “Плюс” (doc 08 §7.2.3)
chunk jargon belongs to SurfEnglish (doc 03 §1.4, R83); the app’s name is «Извлечение Фрагментов»
